definitions: The action of causing to become bent or twisted out of shape.
The action of moving a ship by hauling on a rope attached to a buoy, anchor, or pier.
The action of deviating from a straight line or course.
The action of distorting or altering something from its true or original form.
examples: The wood is warping due to moisture.
They were warping the boat into the dock.
The image is warping on the old screen.
His perception of reality was warping.
